title: 专题：App Studio 改版（Studio 是开发软件包的入口：左右两栏、软件包切换和概览页、列表页按前端样式、专用色和新名字）
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

③ maintainer direct order · Source: the maintainer, 2026-11-26, in the session of seat repo:objectstack#4. ④ This card is a coordination parent. It is not dispatched itself; per the maintainer's order its children are filed only when the topic is picked up. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **定位**：Studio 改名 **App Studio**（中文「应用搭建」），是**开发软件包的入口**。单个软件包的事都在 Studio 里做；「设置 › 软件包」只管全局：列表、安装、导入。
- **外框**：
  - 去掉顶栏，改成和前端一样的左右两栏。
  - 左上角分两行：第一行是 App Studio 标志加折叠按钮；第二行是「‹ 返回应用」加**软件包切换器**，切换器里带「新建软件包」。原来的「⋯」菜单去掉。
  - Studio 用自己的专用色（石墨黑），不跟应用的颜色。
  - 菜单的分组、选中效果和图标照前端做，图标不带底色。
- **菜单**：
  - 第一项是「**概览**」。
  - 数据集移到「数据」组，紧跟对象；它是数据口径，AI 问数也用它。
  - 岗位提到权限集后面。
- **列表页**：
  - 标题加一行工具栏，工具栏只有来源下拉和搜索。去掉面包屑、数字卡片和排序下拉。
  - 表格铺满；名称列先显示业务名，接口名用小字放在下面，并带对象自己的图标和颜色。
  - 来源用「系统自带 / 已修改 / 新建」三种标签。
- **概览页**：就是软件包的详情页，和元数据详情页长得一样，但读写走软件包接口，**不新增元数据类型**。
  - 三个页签：信息、待发布、发布历史。
  - 页头放「导出」和「⋯」（编辑、复制、停用 / 启用、删除）。
- **组织级内容**：按 B 方案处理（见下文「决定」第 11 条），先出决策卡。
- **设置（Setup）跟着调整**：软件包页只做全局列表、安装和导入；「全部环境目录」「诊断」从 Studio 搬到设置；数据源只在设置里管；散落项整理入口放在设置的软件包页；共享规则、队列、分配规则两边写清是谁的；岗位在 Studio 定义、在设置分配，两边互相链接。
- **要你做什么**：现在无。开工时我拆子卡，第 1 项的架构决定修订要你批准合入。

## 维护者说过的（2026-11-26，按先后，节选）

- 「评估这个界面如何优化」「我说的还包括美观度的优化」「先画一个效果图」
- 「Studio 应该是一个专用的企业色，不需要和应用的企业色一致。防止晕了」
- 「左侧菜单的分类效果也参考前端」「左侧菜单选中效果也和前端保持一致」「可以不要背景」
- 「只有 Studio 权限、没有设置权限的开发者，理论上不存在」
- 「App Studio 就是开发软件包的入口吧」
- 「现在你软件包的下拉菜单就只剩切换了，还不如做成切换，加上一个新建按钮」
- 「或者叫概览？」「是不是技术元素太重」「最近发布，我们的修改，都不要放在首页。」「包含的内容，左侧菜单已经有了。」
- 「软件包概览页，是不是就是软件包元数据的详情页？现在没有嘛？」
- 「数据集 是AI 也要用的吧？不能算界面吧」
- 「同意，立专题，不派发」 (the 11-task simplified plan, this topic)
- 「同意」 (the Setup adjustments, decision 12 and tasks 6, 8, 10 and 12)

## Decisions taken in the session

1. **Positioning.** App Studio is the entry for developing a package. Studio does per-package work; Setup → Packages keeps the global list, install and import.
   - This revises ADR-0084, including the #36890 "the dev surface of one app" wording.
   - It revises ADR-0146's split, which kept disable and delete in Setup.
   - It reverses #36501's removal of the package switcher.
2. **Name.** English stays "App Studio". Chinese becomes 「应用搭建」. Only display text changes; the `/studio` address and code identifiers stay.
3. **Shell.**
   - Two columns with no top bar.
   - The top left has two rows: the brand row with the collapse button, then a back button plus the package switcher with "New package". The old ⋯ menu (`StudioPackageMenu`, #37362) is removed.
   - The collapsed rail keeps the app logo and the back button.
4. **Colour.** Studio has its own neutral accent, graphite, and never takes the app's theme colour. Only the app logo keeps the app's colour.
5. **Menu.**
   - Group headers follow the front end and are collapsible.
   - Icons are line icons without a tile.
   - The selected item uses the front end's pill and bar, inset from the edge.
6. **Menu tiers.**
   - Overview is the first entry.
   - `dataset` moves to the data group, directly after object, in the common tier. Its registry `domain` changes from `ui` to `data` at `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:977`; it is an analytics semantic layer that AI ask-data also reads (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts:43-47`). Changing the registry owes an L2 contract review.
   - `position` moves to the common tier, after `permission`.
7. **List page.**
   - The title row holds the type icon, the name, "New X" and help.
   - The toolbar holds a source dropdown (all / modified and new / system-shipped) and a search box.
   - Gone: the breadcrumb, the stat tiles, the refresh button and the sort dropdown. Sorting is by column header.
   - The table is full-bleed with no outer frame. The name column shows the item's own icon and colour (object `icon` and `color` are declared in spec), the label as the primary line and the API name small and mono below. Numbers are right-aligned.
   - "Modified at" and "Source" hide when every row shows the same value. The plural label column is removed from the object list.
   - Source badges read 系统自带 / 已修改 / 新建.
8. **Read-only hint.** A lock beside the app name in the switcher row, plus a tooltip on "New". There is no per-list banner.
9. **Package overview page.**
   - It reuses the item-detail header and tab frame (`StudioItemHeader`).
   - It reads and writes through the package REST surface. ⛔ It does not add a `package` metadata type.
   - Header: name, a 系统自带 or 可写 chip, a 使用中 or 已停用 chip, the description, then "Export" and ⋯ (edit info, duplicate, disable / enable, delete). All of these reuse the existing dialogs and confirmations. What a package kind may do (kernel, code, marketplace, authored) follows the existing rules.
   - Tabs:
     - **Info**: business fields, with the technical fields (id, namespace, type) folded away.
     - **Pending**: reuses the existing changes / publish panel, which loses its top-bar home.
     - **Publish history**: a list plus "revert to last publish".
10. **Setup → Packages** becomes the global list, install and import. Each row opens the package's Studio overview. This folds in #37401.
11. **Organization-level content**, plan B. A decision card comes first.
    - There is no default catch-all package; ADR-0070 D1 and D6 stand.
    - When no package resolves, a create asks the user to pick or create one instead of saving package-less. The UI path goes first; the AI path follows as a cloud card.
    - Legacy loose items are sorted one by one, each with a suggested home, and the `~org` entry retires once they are empty.
    - Environment-bound configuration, such as datasource connections, stays in Setup.
    - The ADR-0150 addressing risk of moving an item into a package is verified first.

12. **Setup follows the split.** Studio develops one package; Setup runs the organization and holds what is global.
    - Setup → Packages is the global list, install, import, marketplace and update notices. Each row opens the package's Studio overview, and the per-package actions leave its sheet (task 8, folding in #37401).
    - The cross-package environment catalog (`~all`) and Diagnostics move from the Studio menu into Setup → Diagnostics, beside Audit Log and Sessions (task 6).
    - Datasources are managed only in Setup → Integrations. A connection is environment-bound configuration, so the Studio menu drops the `datasource` entry (task 6).
    - The loose-item sorting page opens from a banner on Setup → Packages ("N loose items to sort"). The Studio `~org` entry retires once the items are sorted (task 10).
    - Sharing rules, queues and assignment rules exist on both sides with different owners: package-shipped in Studio, organization-authored in Setup. Each side says whose they are and links to the other (task 12).
    - Positions are defined in Studio and assigned in Setup, with links both ways: from a position to "assign in Setup", and from a user to the positions they hold (task 12).
    - Setup → Packages uses the same vocabulary: 系统自带 / 自建 / 应用市场 and 使用中 / 已停用 (task 12).
    - Everything else in Setup is organization operations with no overlap, and stays as it is: people and organization, approvals, configuration, integrations, recycle bin, public forms, OAuth apps and API keys.

## Tasks (to be filed as children when the topic starts)

S ≈ 1 day, M ≈ 2–3, L ≈ 5. These are estimates, not measurements.

| # | Task | Size | Waits for |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Amend ADR-0084 (and ADR-0146's split) for decisions 1–6 and 9–10. Tier H, so the maintainer merges | S | — |
| 2 | Organization-level decision card (decision 11), plus an ADR-0150 addressing spike | S | — |
| 3 | Shell: two columns, the two-row top left, graphite accent, menu styling, switcher with new package, removal of the ⋯ menu, collapsed rail (decisions 3–5 and 8) | L | 1; #37383 and #37368 landed |
| 4 | List page (decision 7) | M | #37383 landed |
| 5 | Package overview page (decision 9) | M–L | 1 |
| 6 | Menu tiers: dataset domain change (L2), position to common, the org-wide default sharing overview renamed; environment catalog and Diagnostics move to Setup → Diagnostics; the `datasource` entry leaves the Studio menu (decision 12) | M | 3 |
| 7 | Naming: display text only, in i18n, docs and skills (the skills text is governed) | S | 1 |
| 8 | Slim Setup → Packages to the global list, install, import and update notices; each row opens the Studio overview; fold in #37401 (decision 12) | M | 5 |
| 9 | Create with no package asks instead of saving package-less (UI path) | M | 2 |
| 10 | Loose-item sorting page, opened from a banner on Setup → Packages; it replaces the Studio `~org` entry | M | 2, 9 |
| 11 | Walkthrough, e2e, platform checklist, docs and skills: widen #36910 to cover this topic | M–L | all |
| 12 | Setup wording and cross-links: whose sharing rules, queues and assignment rules each side shows; position define↔assign links; Setup → Packages vocabulary (decision 12) | S–M | 8 |

**Waves:**
- 3, 4, 5 and 7 run in parallel, because they touch different surfaces.
- 6, 8 and 12 follow.
- 9 and 10 wait for the decision card.
- 11 closes the topic.

The critical path is 1 → 3 → 6 → 11, about 1.5–2 weeks on 4–5 lanes.

## Deferred (not filed; reopen on a named need)

- "Return to a given version" in publish history. The backend supports it; only the UI is missing.
- A "Our changes" tab. The list's source filter covers it.
- An "Enable and disable" tab. It lives in ⋯.
- A marketplace update banner on the overview. Setup's list already shows updates.
- A first-save toast, and empty-package guidance.
- A dedicated "company common" one-click entry. "New package" with "also create an app" unticked covers it.

## Related

- #36890 is the Studio rework epic this builds on. #36909 / PR #37383 and #36907 / PR #37368 must land first.
- #37401, retiring the development face, is folded into task 8.
- #36910 is widened by task 11.
- #37400 was closed as not planned; its "new package" lives in task 3's switcher.
- #37408, the declarative metadata-actions epic (p3), is separate.
